card: This pull request updates doc/i2p.md to document the minimum supported versions of Java I2P (≥ 2.10.0) and i2pd (≥ 2.58.0). Documentation previously claimed any SAM v3.1 router was compatible, but PR #35696 introduced leaseSet encryption settings that fail on older routers. This prevents I2P users from running into connectivity failures caused by outdated router software.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; the patch matches the earlier description.
evidence: PR description: 'Bitcoin Core now relies on a feature that requires recent routers: i2cp.leaseSetEncType=6,4 (introduced in #35696). This is supported by Java I2P ≥ 2.10.0 and i2pd ≥ 2.58.0.'
problem: The documentation previously stated that any SAM v3.1 router could be used, which is inaccurate since PR #35696 introduced a dependency on `i2cp.leaseSetEncType=6,4` that fails on older router releases.

risk.why: This is a documentation-only change to router version recommendations.

summary: Updates `doc/i2p.md` to specify minimum required versions for Java I2P (≥ 2.10.0) and i2pd (≥ 2.58.0). It also clarifies in the Compatibility section that Bitcoin Core relies on specific router features rather than generic SAM v3.1 support.
